with reference to the letter of December 31, 1931 from
H.B.M. Consul te General on the subject of Mrs Clara A. Rosenbloom,
nee Soulevitch, her history and record as known to the Municipal
Police are as follows :-

Mrs Clara A. Rosenbloom, alias C.A.Rosen, alias C.A.Ro-
sen-Borenkloom is a Russian of Jewish origin, born at Kiev on July
27, 1902. In December 1917, together with her parents, she left Rus-
sia for China, arriving in Shanghai in 1918.

In Shanghai she studied at a local school after which
she went to live with her parents. During the period 1920-1922 she
visited Tientsin, Harbin and Tsingtao. In 1924, in Shanghai, she
married a certain Mr.Rosenbloom. They soon separated by mutual con-
sent, but it was not until March 19, 1931 that she formally ob-
tained a divorce from him by a decree of the French Mixed Court.

She is known to have worked for some time as a dancing partner at
Kuhn's Cafe, French Concession and later as a saleslady until
1927, when she bought a boarding house at No 2 Carter Road, which
she subsequently sold in November 1930.

In March 1931 she made an unsuccessful application
at the local British Consulate General for a visa to enable her to
proceed to Hongkong, where, according to her, she had an offer of
employment.

In July 1931 she applied to the local Netherlands
Consulate General for a visa to proceed to Netherlands India, sta-
ting that she desired to go to Java ostensibly on a holiday but
with the object of seeking employment there. This application was
also refused her.

关于英国驻华总领事1931年12月31日就克拉拉·A·罗森布鲁姆夫人（娘家姓苏列维奇）一事所发信函，据工部局警务处所知，其生平及记录如下：

克拉拉·A·罗森布鲁姆夫人，别名 C.A.罗森（C.A.Rosen），别名 C.A.罗森-博伦克卢姆（C.A.Ro-sen-Borenkloom），系犹太裔俄罗斯人，1902年7月27日出生于基辅。1917年12月，她与父母一同离开俄国前往中国，于1918年抵达上海。

在上海，她曾在一所本地学校就读，之后与父母同住。1920年至1922年间，她曾游历天津、哈尔滨和青岛。1924年，她在上海嫁给一位罗森布鲁姆（Rosenbloom）先生。双方不久后协议分居，但直到1931年3月19日，她才通过法国会审公廨的判决正式与其离婚。

据悉，她曾在法租界的库恩咖啡馆（Kuhn's Cafe）担任舞伴工作了一段时间，随后担任售货员，直至1927年。同年，她买下了位于卡特路（Carter Road）2号的一家寄宿公寓，后于1930年11月将其出售。

1931年3月，她向当地英国总领事馆申请前往香港的签证，称在那里已获得工作聘约，但未获成功。

1931年7月，她向当地荷兰总领事馆申请前往荷属东印度的签证，声称希望 ostensibly（表面上）去爪哇度假，实则意在寻找工作。该申请亦被拒绝。

It is also rumoured that she had a paramour with whom
she lived in the French Concession until October 1, 1931 when he
left Shanghai. Since that time she has been residing at No. 26
Avenue, 1025 Bubbling Well Road, a boarding house owned
by her parents, Mr. and Mrs. Soulevitch, who formerly operated
another boarding house at No. 10 Carter Road, which they sold in
October 1931. The latter place was notorious on account of the
fact that it was the residence of many Soviet agents and citizens.
Mrs Rosenbloom's brother, L. Soulevitch, was in the
employ of the local branch of the Chinese Eastern Railway from
1924 to July 1926, and is known to have associated with Soviet
agents visiting Shanghai.
Dmitrievsky, prominent Soviet agent and journalist, resided at Mrs Rosenbloom's boarding house, 10 Carter Road, during
his stay in Shanghai, until he was deported at the request of the
Chinese Authorities in December 1927. It is said that she was his
paramour.
According to our records Mrs Rosenbloom was a source of
annoyance to the police in 1924-25 in connection with the supervision of her boarding house at No. 10 Carter Road, and it was not
until she was summoned and fined by the Provisional Court that she
took out a licence. Later she again appeared before the same tribunal and fined for failing to keep a register of lodgers in accordance with the licence conditions.
Mrs Rosenbloom is registered at the Russian Emigrants

1931年，她在其位于公园路（Park Road）的寓所内经营多台老虎机。
另有传闻称，她有一名情夫，并与之在法租界同居，直至1931年10月1日该男子离开上海。此后，她一直居住在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）1025号26弄的一处寄宿公寓，该房产由其父母苏列维奇夫妇（Mr. and Mrs. Soulevitch）所有。其父母此前曾经营另一家位于卡特路10号的寄宿公寓，并于1931年10月将其出售。后者因曾是许多苏联特工和公民的居住地而臭名昭著。
罗森布鲁姆夫人的兄弟 L. 苏列维奇（L. Soulevitch）于1924年至1926年7月受雇于中东铁路（Chinese Eastern Railway）上海分局，据悉曾与访问上海的苏联特工有往来。
著名苏联特工兼记者德米特里耶夫斯基（Dmitrievsky）在上海期间，曾居住在罗森布鲁姆夫人位于卡特路10号的寄宿公寓，直至1927年12月应中国当局要求被驱逐出境。据说她是他的情妇。
根据我方记录，罗森布鲁姆夫人在1924-25年间因其位于卡特路10号的寄宿公寓监管问题曾给警方带来困扰，直到她被临时法院传讯并罚款后，才办理了执照。后来她再次出庭同一法庭，并因未按执照条件保存住客登记簿而被罚款。
罗森布鲁姆夫人已在虹口路6-A号俄罗斯侨民委员会登记。
G. 普罗科菲耶夫（G. Prokofieff）。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. & S. U. KLUS No S. B. D. 2/33. 8 - 7 - 31. 6th July 1931.）

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that the Consulate
refused a visa for Netherlands India to the following person:
Mrs. Olga Alice Rosen, formerly Mrs. Rosenbloom or Rosenblum,
a spinster, born at Kiev, 20 July 1895, at present living
at 84 Wardan Terrace, Avenue Haig Albert, holder of a
passport, issued by the Bureau of Public Safety at Shanghai
on 7 March 1931, No. 16, registered there under No. 107/31.
    Mrs. Rosen showed a letter, written by Mr. J. Ross of
the M.P.O., on 20 February of this year and addressed to
the Local British Consulate General, recommending her for
a visa to Hongkong and stating that she had been employed
with Lane & Crawford, Whiteaway Laidlaw, and the Canadian
Government Trade Commissioner.
    She also produced a letter from Mr. Proust, dated 14
April 1931, and addressed to the Bureau of Foreign Affairs
(1) stating that by a decree from the French Mixed Court
she was divorced from Mr. Rosenbloom on 19 March 1931.
    According to her own statement she left Russia in
December 1917, coming to Shanghai in 1919, after which
she went to Tientsin (1920-1922), Harbin (1922), Tsingtao,
Shanghai, Japan and Shanghai again.
    When asked why she wanted to go to Java, she stated
that she desired to go on a holiday and in the meantime
would try to find a job there. As to her means of sub-
sistence, she stated to be well provided for, as she could
sublet her house at a profit and would receive an allowance
from her brother, Mr. Rosen, who lives at Carter Road 18.
                                                            Since
R. C. Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,

        SHANGHAI.

    罗森夫人出示了一封由邮政总局（M.P.O.）的 J. 罗斯（J. Ross）先生于今年2月20日撰写并致当地英国总领事馆的信函，信中推荐她获得前往香港的签证，并称她曾受雇于礼查洋行（Lane & Crawford）、惠泰洋行（Whiteaway Laidlaw）以及加拿大政府贸易专员办事处。
    她还出示了普鲁斯特（Proust）先生于1931年4月14日致外事局（Bureau of Foreign Affairs）(1) 的一封信，声明她已于1931年3月19日经法国会审公廨判决与罗森布鲁姆先生离婚。

谨建议警告租户苏列维奇小姐获取工部局执照，这将使警方能够造访该处所并就寄宿者情况进行查询。
卡特路8号位于诺丁山区。
